title: Mario's childhood sightings of craft

tellings.quote: I think about all the times I've ever from a boy when I've seen these things when I'm not them but their their craft.

plain: Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran who says he was abducted by aliens, tells Michels he has seen these beings' craft many times since he was a boy. He speaks of it first-hand, careful to say he means not the beings themselves but "their craft", as part of a life he describes as marked by contact.
